name: SkeletonData
doc: An imported skeleton, ordered for a linear model-space traversal.

fields.name: joints
fields.doc: Parent-before-child joints; at least one joint is required.

fields.name: motionRoot
fields.doc: Root joint whose rigid motion is extracted by the runtime.

fields.name: inverseBind
fields.doc: Explicit mesh-space inverse binds, in joint order. Empty derives them from bind transforms; glTF importers preserve the skin accessor here instead.
